causes.title: Bad data: invalid addresses from one list source

not_a_place.step_variant: Dead addresses bounce on the first email they get, so they always sit on step 1.

fix: Re-verify the hot list source with a second verifier and treat catch-all as unverified.
Suppress every bounced address (blocklist) so no other campaign retries it.
Pause uploads from that source until it passes a 200-lead sample test under 2% bounce.
Smoke-test 100 messages and require < 1% bounce, then resume at 40-50% volume for a week.
do_not: Do not pause inboxes or domains: they are spread evenly and are not the cause.
Do not rewrite copy: 5.1.x means the address does not exist, whatever the email says.

slack.headline: Dead addresses in the list {where}
ruled_out: Not the inboxes or domains (spread over {inboxes} inboxes on {domains} domains). Not the email: a mailbox that doesn't exist bounces whatever it says.
Not the inboxes (spread over {inboxes}). Not the email: a mailbox that doesn't exist bounces whatever it says.
Not the lists (spread over {lists}). Not the email: a mailbox that doesn't exist bounces whatever it says.
Not the email: a mailbox that doesn't exist bounces whatever it says.
do: Re-verify that list before sending to it again, and treat catch-all results as unverified.
Block the {n_sure} addresses that don't exist so no campaign emails them again.{unsure}
slack.dont: Don't pause inboxes or rewrite the email: neither is the cause.

causes.title: Authentication: sending domain fails SPF/DKIM/DMARC
fix: Publish the missing records (SPF include for the mailbox provider, DKIM key, DMARC p=none with rua) and confirm alignment.
Pause the domain's inboxes in all campaigns until a test message shows spf=pass dkim=pass dmarc=pass.
Smoke-test 100 messages and require < 1% bounce, then resume at 40-50% volume for a week.
do_not: Do not re-verify leads: the addresses are fine, the receiver rejects the sender.
Do not move leads to other inboxes on the same domain: they fail the same check.

slack.headline: {where} fails email authentication
slack.headline_elsewhere: Failed email authentication piling up on {where}
why: Receivers reject its mail because its SPF, DKIM or DMARC records are missing or wrong ({codes}).
ruled_out: Not the leads or the email (spread over {lists} lists and {variants} variants). Your other domains, {clean_domains}, pass SPF, DKIM and DMARC and get none of these bounces.
Not the leads or the email: your other domains, {clean_domains}, pass SPF, DKIM and DMARC and get none of these bounces.
Not the leads or the email (spread over {lists} lists and {variants} variants).
do: Take its inboxes out of campaigns until a test email passes SPF, DKIM and DMARC.
slack.dont: Don't re-verify leads: the addresses are fine.

causes.title: Domain reputation: one domain blocked across providers
fix: Pause the domain and rest it (2-4 weeks of warmup-only traffic).
A confirmed Spamhaus DBL listing means retire and replace the domain; do not wait for delisting.
Swap a pre-warmed domain into the campaigns at the same per-inbox caps.
Smoke-test 100 messages and require < 1% bounce, then resume at 40-50% volume for a week.
do_not: Do not rewrite copy first: the block follows the domain to every variant.
Do not add new inboxes on the same domain.

slack.headline: {where} has a bad reputation
why: Several providers block mail from this domain ({codes}).
ruled_out: Not the email or the leads (spread over {variants} variants and {lists} lists). Not one provider either: {providers} different providers block it.
Not one provider: {providers} different providers block it.
do: Take its inboxes out of campaigns and let the domain rest for 2-4 weeks.
If it's on the Spamhaus blocklist, replace the domain instead of waiting.
slack.dont: Don't rewrite the email first: the block follows the domain.

causes.title: Copy fingerprint: one variant blocked across domains and providers
fix: Pause the hot variant.
Send step 1 as plain text with no links and no open/click tracking.
Rewrite with word-level spintax so each send is near-unique; re-test at 5% of volume before resuming.
do_not: Do not re-verify leads: these are content blocks, not invalid addresses.
Do not buy new domains: the copy follows you to any domain.

slack.headline: The email {where} is being blocked as spam
why: It's blocked across different sending domains and providers, so the email itself is the problem ({codes}).
ruled_out: Not the domains, inboxes or leads (spread over {domains} sending domains, {inboxes} inboxes and {lists} lists). Not one provider either: {providers} providers block it.
Not the domains (spread over {domains}). Not one provider either: {providers} providers block it.
do: Its link domain {listed_links} is on the Spamhaus blocklist: replace it in every campaign that uses it.
Rewrite it as plain text without links or tracking, and test it on a small batch first.
slack.dont: Don't buy new domains: the problem follows the email.

causes.title: Recipient gateway: Mimecast/Proofpoint/Barracuda policy blocks
fix: Split leads behind that gateway into their own campaign.
Send to that segment at low volume, plain text, from your best-reputation inboxes.
Tighten targeting: gateway-protected companies are often enterprise accounts that need a different motion.
do_not: Do not touch DNS: Google and Microsoft accept the same mail.
Do not pause inboxes: the block is on the recipient side.

slack.headline: {where} is blocking mail to some recipients
why: These companies' security filter rejects the mail, while Google and Microsoft accept the same mail ({codes}).
ruled_out: Not your domains or the email: Google and Microsoft got {big_sends} of the same emails and blocked {big_blocks}. Not one inbox either (spread over {inboxes}).
Not your domains or the email: Google and Microsoft got {big_sends} of the same emails and blocked {big_blocks}.
do: Move these leads into their own campaign.
Send to them slowly, in plain text, from your best inboxes.
slack.dont: Don't change DNS or pause inboxes: the block is on the recipient's side.

causes.title: Volume throttling: inboxes pushed above safe daily volume
fix: Lower the daily limit on the hot inboxes back to their cap.
Ramp volume by at most 10-15% per week per inbox.
Add inboxes instead of pushing existing ones when the plan needs more sends.
do_not: Do not suppress these leads: 4xx deferrals say nothing about the address.
Do not pause the campaign: the other inboxes are fine.

slack.headline: Too much volume from {where}
why: Providers are slowing down their mail ({codes}). They send up to {now} emails a day; the safe level is {cap}.
Providers are slowing down their mail ({codes}).
ruled_out: Not the leads or the email (spread over {lists} lists and {variants} variants). Not the whole account: the other {other_inboxes} inboxes have {other_bounces} of these bounces.
Not the whole account: the other {other_inboxes} inboxes have {other_bounces} of these bounces.
do: Lower their daily limit to {cap}, then raise it by at most 10-15% a week.
If they're still slowed down after that, check spam complaints too.
slack.dont: Don't remove these leads: the addresses are fine.

causes.title: Sender mailbox: one inbox suspended or over its limit
fix: Remove the inbox from its campaigns.
Check the Google/Microsoft admin console for suspension, a sending limit or a security hold.
Reconnect or replace the inbox; resume after 24-48h at a lower limit.
do_not: Do not pause the campaign: other inboxes are sending fine.
Do not suppress leads: the recipient never saw the message.

slack.headline: The inbox {where} has a problem
why: Its own provider is rejecting its mail: it may be suspended or over a sending limit ({codes}).
ruled_out: Not the domain or the leads: the other {siblings} inboxes on the same domain have {sibling_bounces} of these bounces.
do: Take it out of its campaigns.
Check the Google or Microsoft admin console, then reconnect or replace it.
slack.dont: Don't pause the campaign: the other inboxes are fine.

causes.title: Noise: mailbox full, loops, expired 4xx
fix: No action. These clear on their own; EmailBison's normal bounce handling is enough.
do_not: Do not pause anything for these.
